The reported zero difference is therefore tautological, while global_bias_application_count is a constant field rather than an observed execution count. This does not verify real preprocessing, multi-tile aggregation, or single application of the global extent/wall bias.

forbidden_workarounds: Do not use torch.randn while recording a real case ID.
